attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"We will use testing to advance real learning, not undermine it, by developing high-quality assessments that measure the complex skills students need to develop.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We will ensure that federal law operates with high standards and common sense, not just bureaucratic rigidity.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We will support public school choice, including charter schools and magnet schools that meet the same high standards as other schools.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We will build new schools and offer the technology and equipment for a 21st century education.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We oppose pushing private school vouchers that funnel scarce dollars away from the public schools.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
